 Roberto De Zerbi has three players back and two still out for our Premier League clash against Ipswich Town at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on Saturday (3pm).
 Lucas Bergvall, Savio and Destiny Udogie are all available to face Gary O'Neil's side.
 Lucas has been out since picking up a knee problem in our 1-1 draw at Old Trafford on 10 October. That was also Savio's last appearance - the Brazil winger suffered a muscle injury in training on 13 October and has been out since. Destiny, meanwhile, wasn't in the matchday squad for the 1-0 loss at Leeds last time out on 7 November.
 However, Tosin Adarabioyo remains out having last started against Coventry on 19 October and Mathys Tel is sidelined after picking up an ankle injury at Elland Road.
 Speaking at his pre-match press conference at Hotspur Way on Friday, Roberto reported: "Bergvall, Maddison and Savio are all back. Tosin and Mathys Tel... Tosin is already okay, but it's not the right moment to take any risks. Mathys Tel will be another two, three weeks."
 Roberto also said that winger Mykhailo Mudryk was 'not ready yet'. Longer-term injuries Wilson Odobert and Xavi Simons remain out.
